name: smwpatches-sma2-slide-kill-chain
title: SMA2 Slide Kill Chain
description:
This patch fixes a bug where if Mario kills a sprite by sliding into it, it keeps giving you 200 points and playing the same "kill enemy" sound effect, rather than a having it be a style similar to consecutive stomps.
It also fixes a bug where if the star timer runs out, the kill counter doesn't reset until the player touches an enemy and takes damage.
